audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart disagrees with the packet on both layers. Chart reads [Teemo, Teemo, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill]; packet levelChart is [Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Teemo, Mordekaiser, Teemo, Teemo] at 50.87%. The page's own whys match the packet row for row: whys[1] 'W shield-heal beats his poke', whys[2] 'one combo... halves him', whys[3] 'don't chase a blind you can't punish here', whys[4] 'near-guaranteed kill', whys[5] 'he can deny', whys[6] 'the lane is his'. The header also contradicts itself — diff EVEN, but a red tone, 7/10 difficulty and a 'Hard matchup' rating line.
audit.why: The lane alternates rather than trending: Mordekaiser owns the levels where he can reach Teemo (2, 3, 6) and Teemo owns the ones where Move Quick and range keep him out of Death's Grasp (4-5, both item spikes).
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Levels 2-3 Mordekaiser, Levels 4-5 Teemo, Level 6 Mordekaiser, First item Teemo, 2+ items Teemo. Matched pairs with ratings, plus header made consistent at EVEN/6.

audit.why: Four spikes present and real: Lvl 2-3 Q+E, Lvl 6 Realm of Death (140/120/100s), 1st item, Late shroom map control.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer flattens Blinding Dart to 'Negates your autos' with no cooldown and no scope, even though the content layer already gets it right — the blind stops attacks, not Obliterate or the Darkness Rise aura. Two more interactions never reach the page at all: Toxic Shot is an on-hit poison that scales with attack speed (so armour misreads the trade and magic resist is the real answer), and Guerrilla Warfare lets Teemo hold invisibility while MOVING inside brush, which is exactly where the shrooms sit.
audit.why: 'Negates your autos' invites the reader to stop fighting entirely during the blind; the truth is that Q and the aura keep working, which is the whole reason the level 2-3 window exists. And Guerrilla Warfare explains why chasing him into brush is a shroom, not a catch.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart: 680 range, 7s flat, blinds basic attacks only. Toxic Shot: on-hit poison, no cooldown, scales with attack speed. Move Quick: 14s. Guerrilla Warfare: invisible standing still, and can move while invisible in brush. Noxious Trap: 600/750/900 range, mushrooms bounce off each other for extra range.

edits.before: Q start, but it's slow and telegraphed — Teemo dodges it on reaction at full HP. Last-hit, aim isolated Qs only when he commits to a CS.
edits.after: You have one ability and no aura, but Teemo is only poking too — farm the Q cone at range and don't burn E chasing a kited blind.

edits.before: W banks a cut of the damage you deal and take as shield-health. Short Q-auto trades now come out even or better because half the return damage gets absorbed.
edits.after: W banks a cut of the damage you deal and take as shield-health, and Blinding Dart blanks autos but never Obliterate — bait the dart, then take the trade.

edits.before: Full kit plus Darkness Rise — three hits sets your aura burning and the lane flips. E-drag Teemo off his wave and run the Q-auto-E pattern on every Blinding Dart cooldown.
edits.after: Full kit plus Darkness Rise — E-pull him in, Q the single-target sweetspot, and the aura ticks right through the blind window. One combo halves an escape-less Teemo.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Teemo must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Move Quick lets him kite your aura and stack Toxic Shot on your max HP faster than you grind him — don't chase a blind you cannot punish.

edits.before: Realm of Death online — the 1v1 Teemo cannot decline. R steals 10% of his stats; take the duel whenever Blinding Dart is down and the wave is shoved.
edits.after: Realm of Death online — a 1v1 box with no shrooms and no kite room. Land E first so he cannot dart-and-walk, and it is a near-guaranteed kill.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: His blind refreshes on 7s and Move Quick resets the kite, so a missed E means free poison and a clean walk-off.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Teemo's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Shrooms wall off every choke, his poison out-ranges your whole kit, and he splitpushes past your flat late game — with one E you simply cannot catch him.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Blinding Dart and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by whether you cash levels 2-3 and 6 before his scaling map control does.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10, Teemo carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Teemo carry threat 8/10.

edits.before: Level 3 onward the lane bends your way — the Realm at 6 is the cliff. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 and the Realm at 6 are your windows; 4-5 and both item spikes are his. See the chart for the swing points.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Negates your autos. R when down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: 7s flat, and it blinds autos only — Obliterate and your aura tick straight through it.

edits.before: Negates your autos. R when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blinds autos only, 7s flat — Q and the aura still land. Commit off it.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Guerrilla Warfare hides him moving through brush — that is where shrooms sit.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Toxic Shot is on-hit magic damage that scales with his attack speed, so armour reads the trade wrong — magic resist is what actually cuts it.

edits.before: Track Teemo's Blinding Dart: Negates your autos. R when down. When it is down — R him — the realm is yours.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is 7s and blinds autos only — Obliterate and Darkness Rise tick through it. R once it is spent.

notes: Two things worth the user's attention. (1) The full layer said Blinding Dart 'negates your autos' while the content layer correctly said it does not stop Obliterate or the aura — the same page gave two different answers, and the full-layer version is the one that would make a reader stand still through his best window. Fixed to the content layer's (correct) reading. (2) Header was internally inconsistent again: diff EVEN with a red tone, 7/10 and a 'Hard matchup' line. At 50.87% with the chart splitting 3-3-1 I kept EVEN and brought tone, diffRating, breakdown.difficulty and report[14] into line at 6/10. The _missing on-hit entry now lands in dontsFull[2].d. Recurring kit bug, and the mirror agrees: Obliterate's 'grounding' flag is a parse artifact of 'smashes the ground' — no advice built on it.
